info.name: Audit Log Service - Verification Suite
info.description: End-to-end verification of the Java audit-log service (default http://localhost:8080). Run the WHOLE collection in order (Runner, no parallel) against a fresh ledger using the "Audit Log - Java (8080)" environment.

item.name: 00 Setup and public endpoints
item.description: Run 'init' first (the folder order does this).

admin key has every role (reader endpoint)
admin key has every role (auditor endpoint)

const u=pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/audit/events');function seed(i){if(i===8)return;pm.sendRequest({url:u,method:'POST',header:{'X-API-Key':pm.variables.get('writerKey'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({eventType:'BIG',actorId:pm.variables.replaceIn('pm-{{runId}}-big'),resourceType:'doc',resourceId:'b',payload:{i:i}})}},(error,response)=>{pm.test('export fixture event '+i+' created',()=>{pm.expect(error).to.eql(null);pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(201)});if(error||!response||response.code!==201)throw new Error('Export fixture creation failed at event '+i);seed(i+1);});}seed(0);
